hyperedges.label: Builders that call the AI gateway from the browser

nodes.label: Inline pre-paint theme script
nodes.rationale: Applies data-theme before the first paint so the page never flashes the wrong colours; 'auto' follows the OS preference.

nodes.label: index.html app shell
nodes.rationale: RTL Persian shell: lang=fa dir=rtl, Vazirmatn from Google Fonts, and an inline script that applies the saved theme before first paint.

nodes.label: AI output trust rules
nodes.rationale: Never trust model output: retry truncated replies, salvage complete items, verify titles on Wikipedia and terms in the article text, clamp scores, render text as React text and never as HTML.

nodes.label: Recipe: add a new AI-generated artifact
nodes.norm_label: recipe: add a new ai-generated artifact
nodes.rationale: Type, pure cleaner, prompt and builder with askJson and a Judge, kv load/save, backup/restore, asserts in course.check.ts. Terms was added exactly this way.

nodes.label: OpenAI-compatible AI gateway (ArvanCloud to Gemini 2.5 Flash-lite)
nodes.norm_label: openai-compatible ai gateway (arvancloud to gemini 2.5 flash-lite)
nodes.rationale: Gateway URL, API key and model are typed into Settings and live only in the browser's localStorage, never in code, git or backup files.

nodes.label: Article reader (easy and enhanced modes)
nodes.rationale: Opens the Wikipedia article in the app without AI; enhanced mode has the AI pick key terms once and bolds their first mention per section; formulas missing from plain text are shown as chips.

nodes.label: Course-building pipeline
nodes.rationale: Wikipedia summary and lead links go to the model, which returns prerequisites/next/related scored 0-100 with reasons; each title is verified on Wikipedia with a search fallback; the gateway sometimes truncates answers, so replies are retried up to 6 times.

nodes.label: Static, browser-only architecture
nodes.rationale: No server or database: the browser calls Wikipedia and the AI gateway directly (both allow CORS), so hosting is static files and requests come from the user's own network.

nodes.label: Flashcards, quizzes and Leitner review
nodes.rationale: Per-topic study pack built on demand from the article text (key points, 6 cards, 4 questions); Leitner boxes at 1/2/4/8/16 days; a 75% quiz score counts as known.

nodes.label: Vercel deployment (GitHub import, no env vars)
nodes.norm_label: vercel deployment (github import, no env vars)
nodes.rationale: Push to GitHub and import in Vercel; Vite is auto-detected and no environment variables are needed; each device enters its own AI settings once.

nodes.label: Wiki Course (learning-path app)
nodes.rationale: Personal, local-first app: paste a Wikipedia link, get a learning path (prerequisites, next steps, related) with thumbnails, summaries, AI scores and reasons; mark topics known, review flashcards, take quizzes, export the roadmap or AI-tutor prompts.

nodes.label: Hard rules for agents
nodes.rationale: No secrets or gateway URL, additive persisted data, no emoji and 13px minimum, no HTML from model output, no new dependencies without asking, no commits unless asked.

nodes.label: Verify from a clean clone
nodes.rationale: A stray ~/node_modules/@types/node hid a missing dependency locally and broke the first Vercel deploy; run npm ci && npm run build in a clean clone.

nodes.label: Persisted-data compatibility rules
nodes.rationale: topicKey/courseKey formats live in users' browsers and sample file names, so they never change without a migration; State fields are additive with EMPTY_STATE defaults; backup version bumps on breaking changes.

nodes.label: Knowledge-graph workflow (graphify)
nodes.rationale: Query the graph before grepping, run graphify affected before changing hub functions, run graphify update after structural changes and keep graph.json/graph.html/GRAPH_REPORT.md committed.

nodes.label: UI conventions (tokens, type scale, icons, RTL)
nodes.norm_label: ui conventions (tokens, type scale, icons, rtl)
nodes.rationale: Semantic color tokens only, nothing below 13px, lucide icons and no emoji, logical RTL classes, dir=auto on Wikipedia/AI text, 16px inputs for iOS.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md (rules for AI agents)
nodes.rationale: Short rule list for AI coding agents; points to HANDOVER.md for the full picture.

nodes.label: HANDOVER.md (contributor and agent handover)
nodes.rationale: Entry point for developers and AI agents: what the app is, architecture, data model, AI integration, UI conventions, verification, deployment, known issues, roadmap, graph workflow, contribution rules.

nodes.label: Browser storage and backup/restore
nodes.rationale: Progress, library and notes live in localStorage; courses and packs in Cache Storage; a JSON backup (never containing the AI key) moves everything to another device.

nodes.label: Bundled sample courses
nodes.rationale: Sample course bodies in public/courses with their list in src/data/samples.json; regenerate with npm run build:course; en-Linear_algebra is hand-made.

nodes.label: Known issues and tech debt
nodes.rationale: courseKey collisions (C++ vs C#), duplicate fa() helper, no CI or linter, plain-text reader drops formulas and tables, data is device-local, reliance on gateway CORS.
